meta.title: Thomas Barreto — Full-stack developer
meta.description: Full-stack developer from Río Grande, Tierra del Fuego. Apps and websites in production with React, Next.js, React Native and AWS.

hero.name: Thomas Barreto,
hero.title: Full-stack
hero.sub: I build apps and websites end to end, from idea to the app stores. I've worked remotely with startups in France and Uruguay, and I'm now a full-stack developer at Amaze.

items.text: Landing pages and platforms: MBA Tutor, WeGoGreenR, Amaze and Bitskingdom.
Expo apps, end to end: The Rockin' Chair and Bitskingdom.
At Amaze, campaigns with AI-generated videos personalized for each user. Day to day, I build with AI agents like Claude Code.
Supabase and Node: authentication, databases, file storage and real-time updates. Payments with Stripe and RevenueCat.
At WeGoGreenR I cut monthly AWS costs by 38%.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Real products, in production, built and shipped end to end.
projects.moreNote: Most of my work lives in private repos of clients and companies.

projectsData.title: The Rockin' Chair
projectsData.description: Accessible concerts for every fan. Landing page, app and web app.
projectsData.stack: Expo · React Native · Supabase · RevenueCat · Next.js
projectsData.role: I'm the only developer, working with a designer: I built the landing page, the mobile app (live on the App Store and Google Play) and the web app.

projectsData.title: MBA Tutor
projectsData.description: Landing page for an academy with over 20 years of history.
projectsData.role: I built the landing page with Astro, focused on clarity and speed.

experience.title: Experience
experience.summary: {Years} years building product in startups and small teams, from front-end to infrastructure.

experienceData.summary: I build personalized experiences at scale: in each campaign, every user gets a different version, made for them.
highlights: I also build internal AI tools that automate work for the team.

experienceData.summary: I worked on two products for the agency's clients: an events app and a platform for assigning referees.
highlights: Events app with Expo: built most of the features, including in-app payments on iOS.
Referee platform, with over 8,700 users: notifications and performance.

experienceData.summary: Academic management system for a higher-education institute: students, programs, subjects and exam sessions.
highlights: Built most of it and ran the project, including the client relationship.

experienceData.summary: Sustainable travel platform: a B2B SaaS for accommodations to manage their sustainability and certifications, and a B2C site where travelers book.
highlights: Joined as a front-end developer and ended up leading the tech team of 4.
We built a new front-end that ran alongside the old one and migrated to it piece by piece.
On the B2C platform, I built new features and improved the interface and navigation.
During my time there, the platform gained half of its total users and 43% of all its bookings.

experienceData.short: Front-end in Svelte for a financial company, automating customer service.
Order, inventory and cost management system for a chocolate factory in Río Grande. Built it on my own in 4 months.

editions.story: The very first one: hand-written HTML, CSS and Bootstrap, with my freeCodeCamp certification projects.
editions.note: I only added the projects I had at the time.

editions.story: Chakra UI, Framer Motion and a lot of enthusiasm. Patched up through 2024.
editions.note: I only added two projects from that time (the calculator and AlkyBank) and previews.

editions.context: 4 years of experience · aurora background and glassmorphism
editions.story: Moved to Astro: WebGL aurora background, glassmorphism and effects everywhere.
